Name: Child Needs You
Author: logNest
Description:
[b]Supported languages: [/b]English (English description below), 简体中文

[size=5][b]Child Needs You 孩子需要你[/b][/size]

现在，你的孩子每天都有可能会表达自己的需求：想喝奶，想吃甜品，或者只是想你了。
需求得到满足前，孩子会一直哭。满足需求后，就会重新露出笑容啦～
如果伴侣也在场，还会有相应的反应对话。

每次满足需求，都能增加 25 点孩子好感度；没能满足也不会受到惩罚。

可通过 Generic Mod Config Menu 或编辑 [b]config.json[/b] 配置需求出现的概率，以及开关通知、音效和伴侣的反应对话。

[size=4][b]安装需求[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]《星露谷物语》1.6.14 或更高版本[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.1.7 或更高版本[/*]
[/list]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] 为可选模组，可用于在游戏内调整设置。

[size=4][b]安装方法[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]安装 SMAPI。[/*]
[*]将 ChildNeedsYou 解压到《星露谷物语》的 [b]Mods[/b] 文件夹中。[/*]
[*]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。[/*]
[/list]

[line]

[left][size=5][b]English[/b][/size][/left]

Each day, your children may let you know what they need. They might want some milk, a sweet treat, or simply miss you.
They'll keep crying until their needs are met, then start smiling again!
If your spouse is nearby, they'll have something to say, too.

Meeting a need adds 25 friendship points with that child. There is no penalty for leaving a need unmet.

Use Generic Mod Config Menu or edit [b]config.json[/b] to adjust the chance of a need arising and toggle notifications, sound effects, and spouse reaction dialogue.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.1.7 or later[/*]
[/list]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional and lets you adjust the settings in-game.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract ChildNeedsYou into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
